$comment: Validation uses standard JSON Schema. Before validating, Firefox normalizes platform input in PolicySchemaValidator.sys.mjs: a value delivered as a JSON string is parsed where contentMediaType is application/json, and 0/1 integers become booleans. After validation, strings with format uri become URL objects, and a list entry that fails validation is dropped and logged rather than discarding the whole policy.

DefaultBrowserSettingEnabled.description: Control whether the user can set Firefox as the default browser. If set to false, the default browser check is disabled and the controls for setting Firefox as the default browser are removed from the preferences.

DefaultSerialGuardSetting.description: Set the default permission for websites requesting access to serial ports through the Web Serial API.

oneOf.title: Block serial port access
oneOf.description: No site may access serial ports, and users cannot allow it.

oneOf.title: Ask when a site requests access
oneOf.description: Sites may request access to a serial port and the user is prompted. Users can turn access off.

DisableAppUpdate.description: Turn off application updates within Firefox.

DisableBuiltinPDFViewer.description: Disable the built in PDF viewer.

DisabledCiphers.description: Disable specific cryptographic ciphers, listed below.

DisableDefaultBrowserAgent.description: Prevent the default browser agent from taking any actions.

DisableDeveloperTools.description: Remove access to all developer tools.

DisableEncryptedClientHello.description: Disable the TLS Feature for Encrypted Client Hello.

DisableFeedbackCommands.description: Disable the menus for reporting sites (Submit Feedback, Report Deceptive Site).

DisableFormHistory.description: Turn off saving information on web forms and the search bar.

DisableLaunchOnLogin.description: Prevent Firefox from launching automatically when the user logs in, and prevent the user from enabling this setting. This policy currently only has an effect on Windows.

DisablePasswordReveal.description: Do not allow passwords to be shown in saved logins.

DisablePocket.description: Remove Pocket in the Firefox UI.

DisableProfileImport.description: Remove the ability to import data from other browsers.

DisableProfileRefresh.description: Disable the Refresh Firefox button on 'about:support' and 'support.mozilla.org', as well as the prompt that displays offering to refresh Firefox when you haven't used it in a while.

DisableRemoteImprovements.description: Prevent Firefox from applying performance, stability, and feature changes between updates.

DisableRemoteSettingsAndAcceptSecurityCo.description: Disable Remote Settings updates, stopping Firefox from receiving updated data such as blocklists, and accept the resulting security consequences.

DisableSafeMode.description: Disable safe mode (Troubleshoot Mode) within the browser.

DisableSecurityBypass.description: Prevent the user from bypassing security in certain cases.

DisableSetDesktopBackground.description: Remove the "Set As Desktop Background..." menuitem when right clicking on an image.

DisableSystemAddonUpdate.description: Prevent system add-ons from being installed or updated.

DisableTelemetry.description: Prevent the upload of telemetry data.

DisableThirdPartyModuleBlocking.description: Do not allow blocking third-party modules from the 'about:third-party' page.

DisplayBookmarksToolbar.description: Set the initial state of the bookmarks toolbar.

oneOf.title: Always
oneOf.description: Show the bookmarks toolbar on every page.

oneOf.title: Never
oneOf.description: Hide the bookmarks toolbar.

oneOf.title: New tab only
oneOf.description: Show the bookmarks toolbar only on the New Tab page.

DisplayMenuBar.description: Set the state of the menubar.

oneOf.title: Always shown
oneOf.description: The menu bar is shown and the user cannot hide it.

oneOf.title: Always hidden
oneOf.description: The menu bar is hidden and the user cannot show it, including by pressing Alt.

oneOf.title: Shown by default
oneOf.description: The menu bar starts visible and the user can hide it.

oneOf.title: Hidden by default
oneOf.description: The menu bar starts hidden and the user can show it.

DontCheckDefaultBrowser.description: Don't check if Firefox is the default browser at startup.

DownloadDirectory.description: Set and lock the download directory.

oneOf.title: Standard
oneOf.description: Apply the standard Enhanced Tracking Protection level, which balances protection against site breakage.

oneOf.title: Strict
oneOf.description: Apply the strict Enhanced Tracking Protection level, which blocks more trackers and may break some sites.

EncryptedMediaExtensions.description: Enable or disable Encrypted Media Extensions and optionally lock it.

ExemptDomainFileTypePairsFromFileTypeDow.description: Disable warnings based on file extension for specific file types on domains.

Extensions.description: Control the installation, uninstallation and locking of extensions.

oneOf.title: Allowed
oneOf.description: Users can install extensions.

oneOf.title: Blocked
oneOf.description: No extension can be installed. An extension with its own entry in this policy is exempt, whatever that entry says.

oneOf.title: Extension
oneOf.description: Ordinary browser extensions.

oneOf.title: Spelling dictionary
oneOf.description: Spell-checking dictionaries.

oneOf.title: Language pack
oneOf.description: Language packs that translate the Firefox interface.

oneOf.title: Theme
oneOf.description: Themes that change the appearance of Firefox.

oneOf.title: Site permission add-on
oneOf.description: Add-ons that grant one site access to a restricted capability.

oneOf.title: Allowed
oneOf.description: The extension may be installed, even when extensions are blocked by default.

oneOf.title: Blocked
oneOf.description: The extension cannot be installed, and is uninstalled if already present.

oneOf.title: Force installed
oneOf.description: The extension is installed automatically and the user can neither disable nor remove it.

oneOf.title: Normal installed
oneOf.description: The extension is installed automatically. The user can disable it but cannot remove it.

oneOf.title: Toolbar
oneOf.description: Place the extension's button on the toolbar.

oneOf.title: Extensions panel
oneOf.description: Place the extension's button in the extensions panel instead of the toolbar.

GoToIntranetSiteForSingleWordEntryInAddr.description: Whether to always go through the DNS server before sending a single word search string to a search engine.

oneOf.title: Save to disk
oneOf.description: Download the file instead of opening it.

oneOf.title: Open with a helper application
oneOf.description: Open the content with an application listed in `handlers`.

oneOf.title: Open with the system default application
oneOf.description: Open the content with the application the operating system associates with that type.

Homepage.description: Configure the default homepage and how Firefox starts.

oneOf.title: Blank page
oneOf.description: Start on a blank page.

oneOf.title: Homepage
oneOf.description: Start on the homepage.

oneOf.title: Previous session
oneOf.description: Restore the windows and tabs open at the end of the previous session.

oneOf.title: Homepage, locked
oneOf.description: Start on the homepage and prevent the user from changing the startup page.

oneOf.description: HTTPS-Only Mode is off by default and the user can turn it on.

oneOf.title: Off and locked
oneOf.description: HTTPS-Only Mode is off and the user cannot turn it on.

oneOf.title: On by default

InstallAddonsPermission.description: Configure the default extension install policy as well as origins for extension installs are allowed.

IPProtectionAvailable.description: Control whether Firefox's built-in IP Protection (VPN) is available to users. When disabled, the feature is turned off and cannot be used.

LegacyProfiles.description: Disable the feature enforcing a separate profile for each installation.

LegacySameSiteCookieBehaviorEnabled.description: Enable default legacy SameSite cookie behavior setting.

LegacySameSiteCookieBehaviorEnabledForDo.description: Revert to legacy SameSite behavior for cookies on specified sites.

LocalFileLinks.description: Enable linking to local files by origin.

LocalNetworkAccess.description: Configure local network access security features.

ManagedBookmarks.description: Configures a list of bookmarks managed by an administrator that cannot be changed by the user.

MicrosoftEntraSSO.description: Allow single sign-on for Microsoft Entra accounts on macOS.

NetworkPrediction.description: Enable or disable network prediction (DNS prefetching).

NewTabPage.description: Enable or disable the New Tab page.

NoDefaultBookmarks.description: Disable the creation of default bookmarks.

OfferToSaveLogins.description: Control whether or not Firefox offers to save passwords.

OfferToSaveLoginsDefault.description: Sets the default value of 'signon.rememberSignons' without locking it.

PasswordManagerEnabled.description: Remove access to the password manager via preferences and blocks about:logins on Firefox 70.

PasswordManagerExceptions.description: Prevent Firefox from saving passwords for specific sites.

PDFjs.description: Disable or configure PDF.js, the built-in PDF viewer.

Permissions.description: Set permissions associated with camera, microphone, location, notifications, autoplay, and virtual reality.

oneOf.title: Allow audio and video
oneOf.description: Sites may autoplay both audio and video.

oneOf.title: Block audio
oneOf.description: Sites may autoplay video without sound, but not audio.

oneOf.title: Block audio and video
oneOf.description: Sites may not autoplay anything.

PictureInPicture.description: Enable or disable Picture-in-Picture as well as prevent the user from enabling or disabling it (Locked).

PopupBlocking.description: Allow certain websites to display popups and be redirected by third-party frames.

PostQuantumKeyAgreementEnabled.description: Enable post-quantum key agreement for TLS.

oneOf.title: Set the default value
oneOf.description: Change the preference's default value. A value the user has already set still wins.

oneOf.title: Set and lock
oneOf.description: Change the preference's default value and prevent the user from changing it.

oneOf.title: Set as a user value
oneOf.description: Set the preference as though the user had set it, so the value is written to the profile.

oneOf.title: Clear the user value
oneOf.description: Remove any value the user has set, reverting the preference to its default.

oneOf.title: Number
oneOf.description: Store `Value` as an integer. Set this explicitly for 0 and 1, which are otherwise stored as booleans.

oneOf.title: Boolean
oneOf.description: Store `Value` as a boolean.

oneOf.title: String
oneOf.description: Store `Value` as a string.

PrimaryPassword.description: Require or prevent using a primary (formerly master) password.

PrivateBrowsingModeAvailability.description: Set availability of private browsing mode.

oneOf.title: Available
oneOf.description: The user can open private windows.

oneOf.title: Disabled
oneOf.description: Private windows and 'about:privatebrowsing' are unavailable.

oneOf.title: Forced
oneOf.description: Every window is a private window.

PromptForDownloadLocation.description: Ask where to save each file before downloading.

oneOf.title: No proxy
oneOf.description: Connect directly, without a proxy.

oneOf.title: Use system settings
oneOf.description: Use the proxy configured in the operating system.

oneOf.title: Manual configuration
oneOf.description: Use the proxy hosts given in `HTTPProxy`, `SSLProxy`, `FTPProxy`, and `SOCKSProxy`.

oneOf.title: Auto-detect (WPAD)
oneOf.description: Discover the proxy settings for this network automatically.

oneOf.title: Automatic proxy configuration (PAC)
oneOf.description: Use the proxy auto-configuration file at `AutoConfigURL`.

oneOf.title: SOCKS v4
oneOf.description: Use version 4 of the SOCKS protocol to reach `SOCKSProxy`.

oneOf.title: SOCKS v5
oneOf.description: Use version 5 of the SOCKS protocol to reach `SOCKSProxy`.

RequestedLocales.description: Set the list of requested locales for the application in order of preference.

SanitizeOnShutdown.description: Clear specified data on shutdown, such as History, Cookies, Logins, Cache, Form History, Site Preferences and Offline Website Data.

SearchBar.description: Set whether or not search bar is displayed.

oneOf.title: Address bar only
oneOf.description: Search from the address bar, with no separate search box.

oneOf.title: Separate search box
oneOf.description: Add a search box to the toolbar, next to the address bar.

SearchEngines.description: The following policies allow for configuring search engines in Firefox.

oneOf.title: GET
oneOf.description: Send the search terms as part of the URL.

oneOf.title: POST
oneOf.description: Send the search terms in the request body, using `PostData`.

ShowHomeButton.description: Show the home button on the toolbar.

SitePolicies.description: Fine grained control over policies for specific sites.

SkipTermsOfUse.description: Configure display settings for the Firefox Terms of Use and Privacy Notice on startup.

SSLVersionMax.description: Set and lock the maximum version of TLS.

SSLVersionMin.description: Set and lock the minimum version of TLS.

StartDownloadsInTempDirectory.description: Force downloads to start off in a local, temporary location rather than the default download directory.

SupportMenu.description: Add a menuitem to the help menu for specifying support information.

UserMessaging.description: Prevent Firefox from messaging the user in certain situations.

UseSystemPrintDialog.description: Use the system print dialog instead of the print preview window.

WindowsSSO.description: Allow Windows single sign-on for Microsoft, work, and school accounts.

XSLTEnabled.description: Enable or disable support for the XSLTProcessor JavaScript API and the XSLT processing instruction.
